candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500, so the checkout 502s originate from an order-service server error.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side telemetry (logs, traces, metrics) is absent, so the internal cause of the order 500 is not established.

report.explanation: Gateway traces and logs show POST /v1/checkout returning 502 because the downstream POST /v1/orders call to order:8000 returns 500. The bounded candidate is an order-service HTTP 500 propagating to the gateway. Order-side telemetry is missing, so the underlying fault cannot be narrowed further.
